The University of Michigan researchers collect nationwide surveys each month – asking people about business conditions, buying conditions, and personal finances – and use the feedback to calculate a consumer sentiment index.

Views of personal finances inched down this month, while expected business conditions took a bigger hit, sinking 11% for the short run and 17% for the long run. [...] The University of Michigan updated its consumer sentiment index Friday with a preliminary August reading of 51, down about 8% from the final July index reading of 55.2.

The final August consumer sentiment index will be released on the 28th.
